review.why: Selects the dbt CLI and explicit resource scope, previews data and catches selector mistakes.
review.summary: Practical CLI guide. A real local Core/DuckDB build and exact-total test passed; a misspelled selector correctly failed with warn-error enabled. This does not test Fusion or Cloud CLI compatibility.
cautions: Prefer project instructions over blanket build defaults
Full-refresh and cleanup commands need task-specific judgment
